title: Moose (legacy plan.yaml migrations)
description: MooseStack 0.6.521 running the legacy plan.yaml migration workflow — the default before the delta-based migration system was enabled. Paired with moose-delta-migrations to isolate the impact of the migrate_with_deltas feature flag.
postInstallScript: mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.521
